title: Grant S3 Read Permission to a Lambda
description: Write an IAM policy and attach it to the Lambda role so the function can read a specific S3 bucket.
problemStatement: A Lambda function named `DataProcessor` needs to read objects from an S3 bucket named `my-data-bucket` in the same account. It should be able to list the bucket and get objects, but not delete or write anything. Write the IAM policy (JSON) to be added to the Lambda's execution role. Also explain where in the IAM console you would attach this policy (managed vs inline) and why you might prefer one over the other.
hints: Use a customer managed policy for reusability.
expectedOutput: IAM policy JSON and explanation of attachment method.
